result.text: Based on the measured signal, using the optical and SAR images jointly: built-up / man-made surface 10.7% (10.5 ha); water-covered 12.3% (12.1 ha); vegetation 24.1% (23.6 ha). Cross-modal agreement — water kappa 0.04 (optical 12.4%, SAR 1.3%); built-up / man-made sur….
